body: QWEN CHAT HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DASHSCOPE GITHUB PAPER DEMO DISCORD We release Qwen2.5-Omni, the new flagship end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series. Designed for comprehensive multimodal perception, it seamlessly processes diverse inputs including text, images, audio, and video, while delivering real-time streaming responses through both text generation and natural speech synthesis. To try the latest model, feel free to visit Qwen Chat and choose Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. The model is now openly available on Hugging Face, ModelScope, DashScope,and GitHub, with technical documentation available in our Paper.
